Request tours and tickets News Press Releases Contact Get Help Write to Rob Close Congressman Rob Menendez Modal Search Button MENU ES Healthcare Every American has a right to quality and affordable healthcare. Under the Trump Administration, healthcare is under attack for millions of Americans. House Republicans passed the largest cut to Medicaid and Affordable Care Act (ACA), protections in history, and millions of children, seniors, and people with disabilities will lose access to healthcare. As a member of the House Energy and Commerce Committee, I am fighting back alongside House to protect Medicaid and defend the care millions rely on. We should be building on landmark legislation like the ACA which took critical steps to lower costs, expand coverage for underinsured and uninsured populations, and ensure Americans cannot be denied coverage due to pre-existing conditions, instead of making it harder for people to access care. I am committed to finding effective solutions to our nation’s healthcare challenges that prioritize patients and lower costs for American families.

Request tours and tickets News Press Releases Contact Get Help Write to Rob Close Congressman Rob Menendez Modal Search Button MENU ES Immigration Our district has a proud immigrant history, and our communities are proof that America’s strength comes from its diversity. Right now, the Trump Administration is sowing chaos and tearing families apart across the country. As the proud grandson of Cuban refugees, I will continue to stand up for all of our neighbors, conduct legal oversight of detention facilities, and fight back against this Administration’s attempts to undermine the rights of everyone who calls this country home. We must develop real, longstanding solutions for the challenges that plague America’s broken immigration system, including a pathway to citizenship, fair immigration laws, robust asylum protections, closing private detention centers, and expanded capacity to address our national immigration court backlog. As Vice Chair for Policy for the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, I am focused on protecting our immigrant communities and enacting border security policies that are humane, effective, and reflective of our values as a nation.

Request tours and tickets News Press Releases Contact Get Help Write to Rob Close Congressman Rob Menendez Modal Search Button MENU ES Helicopters Since coming to Congress, I have heard from countless residents who are concerned about high volumes of non-essential helicopter traffic over our communities. We have continuously pushed the FAA and other federal authorities to address these dangerous conditions, excessive noise, and the role that helicopters play in this challenge. The tragic crash on the Hudson River in April 2025 was a clarion call for every level of government to take action on helicopter safety. We doubled down on our efforts and continued to partner with air safety officials to ensure that we prevent future tragedies and safeguard our communities from the pervasive issue of non-essential helicopter traffic in the region. I am also fighting the negative impacts that helicopter noise pollution has had on many areas of our communities by advocating for the National Park Service (NPS) and the FAA to designate Liberty State Park as an avoidance area for helicopter traffic and by introducing the Communities Before Air Tourism Act. I introduced the Protecting Communities from Helicopter Noise Act and the Communities Before Air Tourism Ac t, which aim to reduce the number of helicopter flights in the New York-New Jersey metropolitan area. Request tours and tickets News Press Releases Contact Get Help Write to Rob Close Congressman Rob Menendez Modal Search Button MENU ES Working Families Our families deserve a workplace that is safe, dignified, and provides quality pay and benefits. While costs have gone up for many Americans, wages have not kept pace, and families are struggling to stay ahead. For generations, unions have provided a pathway to the middle class for working families across America. Since the early 1980s, unionization rates have fallen by almost half while anti-worker efforts such as “right to work” laws and union busting have been on the rise. As a proud Member of the Labor Caucus, I am committed to finding solutions that support the middle-class and all working families. I introduced the Working Families Task Force Act , which will bring together officials from across the federal government to work on solutions for the issues impacting working families, including affordability, access to childcare, and wage growth. And as a founding member of the Dads Caucus, I introduced the Parental Workforce Training Act , legislation establishing a federal pilot program to help parents afford childcare while enrolled in workforce training. Request tours and tickets News Press Releases Contact Get Help Write to Rob Close Congressman Rob Menendez Modal Search Button MENU ES Transportation and Infrastructure Our communities are a hub for all modes of transportation - not only in the Northeast, but the nation at large. Our public transportation system must meet the current and future needs of our workforce, communities, and economy. While there have been significant investments in our infrastructure through the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA) , our nation is still facing issues with supply chains, outdated equipment, and crumbling infrastructure that was not built for the 21st Century. We must continue to invest in projects such as the Gateway Program – the largest critical infrastructure project in the country – which runs through the district. It is essential that funding for Gateway is maintained and the project is completed on-time. That’s why I’ve led efforts in the House to hold the Trump Administration accountable for its efforts to needlessly withhold that funding for partisan purposes. I believe in making these investments because our residents deserve best-in-class public transit options and because our nation’s infrastructure is a reflection of our collective will to do big, bold things in this country.

Request tours and tickets News Press Releases Contact Get Help Write to Rob Close Congressman Rob Menendez Modal Search Button MENU ES Climate Change and Environmental Justice Our children and grandchildren deserve a healthy and livable planet. But right now, the Trump Administration and congressional Republicans are gutting environmental protections, slashing funding for climate change initiatives, and turning their backs on the work we’ve done and must continue to do to ensure that we are leaving a better planet for our future generations. On the House Energy and Commerce Committee, I’ve voted against harmful cuts to key climate and energy programs and anti-environment bills that would raise costs for our families and makeour planet less livable. And as the representative of environmental justice communities that have borne the cost of fossil fuels and industrial pollution for far too long, I am fighting for a clean energy economy that keeps costs low, generates good paying jobs, reduces our dependence on extractive industries, and ensures that frontline communities share in and lead our transition to net-zero.

Menendez instó al secretario del Departamento de Seguridad Nacional (“ DHS ”), Markwayne Mullin, y al alto funcionario de Inmigración y Control de Aduanas (“ ICE ”), David Venturella, a detener esta práctica, y garantizar que no se realicen más expulsiones hacia países de los que el DHS luego afirma no poder repatriar a las personas deportadas, y a cesar el uso de deportaciones a terceros países para impulsar la agenda de deportaciones masivas del presidente Trump. La acción se produce luego de la deportación por parte de la Administración Trump de Adriana Quiroz Zapata, electora del congresista Menendez y ciudadana colombiana protegida bajo la Convención contra la Tortura, a la República Democrática del Congo. Request tours and tickets News Press Releases Contact Get Help Write to Rob Close Congressman Rob Menendez Modal Search Button MENU ES Home News Press Releases May 21, 2026 Menendez Responds to Raúl Castro Indictment WASHINGTON, D.C. – Congressman Rob Menendez responded to the indictment of Cuban dictator Raúl Castro for his role in the 1996 downing of two Brothers to the Rescue planes with the following statement: “As a Cuban American, I know the immense suffering that the Castro regime has inflicted on the Cuban people over 67 years of brutal repression and authoritarian rule. “The indictment of Raúl Castro – on Cuban Liberation Day – provides long overdue justice for the families of the four Americans killed on the Castro regime’s orders in 1996. “At the same time, I have concerns about what the Trump Administration may do next and I do not believe that these charges should be used to justify an attempt at regime change by the Trump Administration akin to what we saw happen in Venezuela. “I want to see the people of Cuba finally have their freedom, to see all political prisoners released, and for the regime’s oppressive grip to be lifted after generations of suffering. Real democratic reforms for Cuba must be enacted by the Cuban people, not by another illegal war.”   Print   Email   Share Previous Article Next Article
